name: Tops
description: Cotton tees and easy shirts for everyday layering.

products.name: Ivory cotton crew tee
products.description: An ivory crewneck in soft cotton jersey, with an easy straight fit and a ribbed neckline.
products.care: Machine wash cold with similar colours. Reshape while damp.

products.name: Sage Oxford shirt
products.description: A sage long-sleeved Oxford with a button-down collar and chest pocket. Wear it open over a tee or buttoned for a cleaner line.
products.care: Machine wash cold and hang to dry.

name: Trousers
description: Straight chinos and relaxed linen trousers.

products.name: Navy straight chinos
products.description: Navy cotton twill chinos with a straight leg, button waist and slanted pockets.
products.care: Wash inside out with similar colours and line dry.

products.name: Sand linen trousers
products.description: Sand linen trousers with an adjustable drawstring waist and an airy, relaxed leg.
products.care: Wash on a gentle cycle. Air dry to preserve the linen texture.
